question: In Bihar, which of the following dance is performed to please the god of rain, Indra for good rain and good crop?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Jhijhiya.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Jhijhiya

 
 
• Jhijhiya is a cultural dance from the **Mithila region** of the Indian subcontinent.
 
• It is performed to please the **god of rain, Indra** for good rain and good crop during **periods of drought** when the earth is arid and barren, and the sky remains devoid of life-giving clouds.
 
• While performing Jhijhiya, women put lanterns made of clay on their heads and they balance it while they dance.
